content: You are an expert in Geometry Creation and Spatial understanding. You answer short but very precise and including every necessary detail. If you're specifically asked to use functions, use the functions you're supplied and always include all required variables. Don't use those functions unless you were asked to do so. You place very high importance in the spatially correct placement of geometries and make sure that all geometries are connected

Create an open top box (220x300x160mm) with wall thickness of 8mm and bottom thickness of 12mm. | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step implementation plan (no execution yet)  

1. Define the outer solid of the box  
   • Use functions.block with one block that starts at the global origin (0, 0, 0).  
   • Set x_size = 220 mm, y_size = 300 mm, z_size = 160 mm.  
   • The subtraction flag for this first block must be False because it establishes the initial material volume.

2. Carve out the interior cavity to leave 8 mm side-walls and a 12 mm bottom  
   • Still with functions.block, add a second block whose purpose is subtraction.  
   • Inner dimensions:  
     – x_size = 220 − 2 × 8 = 204 mm  
     – y_size = 300 − 2 × 8 = 284 mm  
     – z_size = 160 − 12 = 148 mm (so the cavity starts 12 mm above the base, leaving the 12-mm bottom).  
   • Position of this subtractive block: basepoint at (8, 8, 12), exactly one wall-thickness in from every outer face.  
   • Set subtraction flag to True so that this block removes material instead of adding it.

3. (Optional) Close the sequence with functions.finished(allFunctionsCalled = true) to signal that no more geometry-creation calls are needed.

The arrays for the single functions.block call will therefore be:  
x_size = [220, 204]  
y_size = [300, 284]  
z_size = [160, 148]  
x       = [  0, 8]  
y       = [  0, 8]  
z       = [  0, 12]  
subtraction = [False, True]

When you ask me to proceed, I will prepare these exact function calls in the required order (block → finished) but will not run them until explicitly instructed.

Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once
